_review: Each entry is one site's fixed page for the sign-in health check, {"url": an https URL on that site, "shows": words only a signed-in visitor sees on it}. The check runs no page script, so the page must show those words from the server, and a signed-out visitor must be redirected by the server to a sign-in page (one sent away only by script reads unknown). Review rule: opening the URL must change nothing on the account (no mark as read, no log out, no confirm, no unsubscribe, no one-time link), and it must not be a page that pays, nor one whose own scripts act on load (a GET a script sends on load can still change something on a badly built site). The check opens it with GET only, never clicks or types, and keeps only the verdict.
